set_aside.subject: repeated import after restore
set_aside.text: A store lost before a checked backup holds the import loses the import with it, and the import may then be made again
set_aside.question: When the first import minted new `customer_ref` values for legacy customers, must the repeated import recreate those same values, or may it mint different ones; if they must be stable, what retained fact supplies them?
options: retain and reuse the first import's generated customer mapping
derive the same mapping deterministically from the export
mint new customer identities and require consumers to be relinked again
set_aside.default_guess: retain and reuse the first import's generated customer mapping

set_aside.subject: restore recovery point
set_aside.text: every change after it is lost, the audit entries with it
set_aside.question: After which event are changes lost: creation of the restored backup, the backup's check, loss of the store, or another recovery point?
options: all changes after the restored backup was taken
all changes after that backup was checked
all changes after the store was lost
set_aside.default_guess: all changes after the restored backup was taken

set_aside.subject: durability of completed actions
set_aside.text: every change after it is lost ... Where either record is missing, what the restored store holds stands until the owner corrects it
set_aside.question: Does R0-89 narrow the earlier observable outcomes that erased data is gone, anonymisation is final, restrictions and relationship endings hold, and audit entries are erased, so that all may be reversed by restoring an older backup and may remain reversed when the external record is missing?
options: yes, every such outcome is guaranteed only within one store history
no, privacy and retention actions must remain effective across restore
only the actions expressly listed in R0-89 may be reversed
set_aside.default_guess: yes, every such outcome is guaranteed only within one store history

set_aside.subject: retention-review replay
set_aside.text: What the owner repeats after a restore — erasures, restrictions, ends of a relationship, the latest date audit entries were erased by — follows the owner's record of the retention review
set_aside.question: Which state changes must the governance record preserve and the owner replay: only setting restrictions and ending relationships, or also lifting restrictions, resuming relationships, and the anonymised-versus-deleted choice for each project erasure?
options: record and replay both directions and every erasure variant
record and replay only the four categories literally listed
record final desired state rather than individual actions
set_aside.default_guess: record and replay both directions and every erasure variant

set_aside.subject: audit-erasure recovery fact
set_aside.text: the latest date audit entries were erased by
set_aside.question: Is this the cutoff supplied to `erase audit entries before a date`, or the calendar date on which the owner performed that action?
options: the cutoff date before which entries were erased
the date the erasure action was performed
set_aside.default_guess: the cutoff date before which entries were erased

set_aside.subject: missing recovery records
set_aside.text: Where either record is missing, what the restored store holds stands until the owner corrects it
set_aside.question: Which two records does “either record” mean, and what concrete correction is possible when the missing record leaves the owner without the facts needed to reconstruct the lost action or import?
options: the retention-review record and the retained migration material
the export file and the separate import choices
set_aside.default_guess: the retention-review record and the retained migration material
